name: 70507 · Lafayette, LA
findings: ZIP 70507 (Lafayette) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70507 (Lafayette) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70507 (Lafayette) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.
